critical_code_review_comments: BrandLogo.jsx renders a fixed 1725x560 img; on very small viewports the intrinsic width is fine because the CSS scales it, but consider adding loading='lazy' + fetchpriority='high' hint for the navbar copy to avoid a small LCP regression on slow 3G.

Favicon href in public/index.html points to /brand/icon.png (200 image/png). Consider also updating <meta name='theme-color'> to the new navy #071D32 if not already, for a coherent PWA/browser chrome tint.

seed.py DEFAULT_SETTINGS + one-time identity migration path is correctly scoped to logo/colors/font/version and does not touch sites/templates/integrations — verified by API (30 templates keep their diverse primaries, no navy override).

Templates.jsx live-preview canvas correctly scopes brand CSS variables to the preview subtree — palette leakage between the marketing platform shell and per-template preview does NOT occur (verified by DOM getComputedStyle inside data-testid='preview-canvas').
